text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh my goooood! I lost, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I lose, everyone cheering for me will 
be unhappy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That will not do! I shall win the next 
race and bring a happy smile to everyone's 
face, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, let's hurry back and 
train! Trainer, hurry up!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best together!
We need to have our review meeting first!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, let's hurry back and 
train! Trainer, hurry up!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best together!
We need to have our review meeting first!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course! I'm counting on you! Next 
time will definitely be a VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please prepare some celebratory roast beef 
and wait for me♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's right! The reflection 
meeting...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, feedback is crucial! Because I 
don't want to lose the same way again!
